$comment: Element type library. Each type configures a builder (builders.json) with defaults, layer, model group, schedule and label prefix. Default dimensions are generic, indicative values for early design and MUST be replaced with manufacturer, botanical or regulatory data where relevant ('reviewRequired' lists parameters that trigger a validation warning while undefined or not sourced). Users can add types in a user catalog file with the same structure.

defaults.buildup: Vegetation mat, substrate, filter, drainage, root barrier
